tools.name: Embeddings
tools.description: This reactor is used to interact with Embedding Model Engines. If the model does not support embeddings it will return "This model does not support embeddings."
tools.title: Embeddings

paramValues.description:
Param Options depend on the engine implementation
					FAISS:
						chunkUnit	-	(OPTIONAL) The unit that detemines how to measures the length of given chunks. Options are "tokens" or "characters".
						columnsToIndex	-	(OPTIONAL) A list of column names in the data you want to create the embeddings from
						columnsToRemove	-	(OPTIONAL) A list of column names in the data that you dont want to store in the database
						contentLength	-	(OPTIONAL) The content length represents the upper limit of tokens within a chunk, as determined by the embedder's tokenizer.
						contentOverlap	-	(OPTIONAL) The number of tokens from prior chunks that are carried over into the current chunk when processing content.
						extractionMethod	-	(OPTIONAL) The name of the extraction method used to pull data from PDF(s). Options are "fitz" or "default".
						keywordSearchParam	-	(OPTIONAL) Create keywords from the extracted chunks and use them to when to create embeddings.
						customDocumentProcessor	-	(OPTIONAL) Boolean flag to determine whether a custom function is being used to process a document
						customDocumentProcessorFunctionID	-	(OPTIONAL) Indicates the function ID used to custom process a document
